title: The Effect of Accelerometer Guided App Feedback on Change in Activity in Patients With Low Back
brief_summary: In a cross-over, open-label, randomized, controlled trial, the investigators aim to determine if the daily activity level in patients with LBP can be increased via feedback from an app, connected to a wearable sensor of physical activity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* non-specific low back pain, spinal stenosis, radiculopathy
* moderate disability or worse (20-100 points on Oswestry Disability Index)

Exclusion Criteria:

* co-morbidity making the patients unable to move
* unsufficient Danish-skills
* patients who already monitored their activity by watch or phone on a daily basis
* allergy to band-aid
* pregnancy or breast-feeding
* patients referred for back-surgical evaluation
